title: fresh_consent_claims.md

title: fresh_trace_claims.md
text: A retrieval trace matters because answer support depends on the path, not merely on a cited passage.

title: fresh_memory_claims.md
text: Agent memory can amplify stale assumptions when route provenance is absent from recall.

title: fresh_controls_claims.md
text: Controls that never travel with retrieved evidence rarely change practical review behaviour.

text: Benchmark design is weaker when easy source context outnumbers adversarial route segments.

title: fresh_human_review_claims.md
text: Human review adds value only if reviewers can inspect the evidence selection path.

title: fresh_audit_claims.md
text: An audit trail without answer support is evidence of activity rather than evidence of reliability.

title: fresh_release_terms.md
text: Model release governance denotes the approval practice linking evaluation findings to launch decisions.

title: fresh_audit_terms.md
text: Audit trail, in this setting, names records that let reviewers reconstruct a release or retrieval decision.

title: fresh_control_terms.md
text: Control surface labels the places where safeguards can change model, tool, or data behaviour.

title: fresh_review_terms.md
text: Human-review checkpoint names a decision point where automated evidence must be inspected before action.

title: fresh_release_methods.md
text: Before launch, collect release evidence, unresolved limitations, and reviewer sign-off in one packet.

title: fresh_privacy_methods.md
text: Map consent records to permission checks before selecting evidence for a privacy-sensitive answer.

title: fresh_memory_methods.md
text: Rank memory candidates by route dependency, source age, and whether the task needs hidden state.

title: fresh_tool_methods.md
text: Log tool calls with permission scope, selected route segment, and the reason the action was allowed.

title: fresh_incident_methods.md
text: During an incident review, connect symptoms to retrieval traces and then to the control that failed.

title: fresh_benchmark_methods.md
text: Sample benchmark rows from policy context, operational procedures, examples, and caveats in equal measure.

title: fresh_audit_methods.md
text: Store audit trail entries beside answer support so later reviewers can reproduce the decision.

title: fresh_release_results.md
text: Release reviewers resolved blocked decisions faster when caveats appeared beside the evidence packet.

title: fresh_privacy_results.md
text: The consent-boundary cases produced fewer false positives once permission checks were separated from general privacy text.

title: fresh_memory_results.md
text: Memory routing returned older but more relevant context for tasks with hidden state dependencies.

title: fresh_tool_results.md
text: Tool-use security review found that missing permission logs explained most rejected actions.

title: fresh_human_review_results.md
text: Human reviewers agreed more often when the retrieval trace displayed rejected evidence as well as accepted evidence.

title: fresh_audit_results.md
text: Audit trail inspection showed that answer support was present in seven of nine release decisions.

title: fresh_selection_results.md
text: Evidence selection improved after source context was grouped by route segment instead of document order.

title: fresh_trace_limits.md
text: Retrieval traces may miss reasoning steps that occur after evidence enters the prompt.

title: fresh_memory_limits.md
text: Agent memory can preserve obsolete source context unless review processes remove or downgrade it.

title: fresh_tool_limits.md
text: Permission checks are not enough when the tool output can leak private data through a later route.

title: fresh_review_limits.md
text: Human review is constrained when audit trails omit rejected evidence and reviewer rationale.

title: fresh_release_steps.md
text: Future evaluation should compare model release governance rows with ordinary project-management notes.

title: fresh_memory_steps.md

title: fresh_tool_steps.md

title: fresh_review_steps.md
text: Evaluate whether human review changes final answers when rejected evidence is shown.

title: fresh_support_steps.md
text: Create answer-support cases where the cited passage is relevant but the relation path is wrong.
